screen_frame_judge: Deliberate: the feature it serves is default-OFF and stays off on-prem. Meeting-note screenshots (#12135) require SCREEN_FRAME_EGRESS_ENABLED to be exactly 'true' (utils/screen_frames/availability.py:38), an explicit opt-in upstream added because the lane is egress by construction. The judge is a VISION model (gemini-2.5-flash-lite); our on-prem stack serves qwen2.5:14b for text and bge-m3 for embeddings, no vision model — pinning it to a text model would return confident nonsense about images, which is worse than not routing it. DEBT: if an operator does enable the flag on-prem, the judge reaches Gemini, because the lane has no vendor-egress gate the way Hume prosody does (config/vendor_egress.py). See BACKLOG.
web_search: Deliberate: Perplexity-only, a search PRODUCT rather than an LLM lane. Pinning it to the local chat model would return invented 'Web Search Results' with a fabricated 'Sources:' section, which is worse than no web search. utils/retrieval/tools/perplexity_tools.py fails soft on a non-200 ('Web search is temporarily unavailable'), and live the lane answers 503 invalid_config with no perplexity credentials. Revisit if a self-hostable search backend is added.
